doc.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Lunch break and room temperature; scheduling the rest of the interview
summary: The room is overheated, staff arrange for an engineer and lunch, and they work out whether the interview continues tomorrow given Walton's gig and travel.
